name: What Beats Learning
install:
npm ci
if [ ! -f .dev.vars ]; then sed "s|^COOKIE_ENCRYPTION_KEY=.*|COOKIE_ENCRYPTION_KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)|" .dev.vars.example > .dev.vars; fi

terminals.name: wrangler dev
terminals.command: if [ -n "$CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" ]; then npx wrangler dev; else npx wrangler dev --local; fi
terminals.description: Cloudflare Workers dev server for the What Beats Learning MCP on http://localhost:8788. If CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is set (add it in the Secrets panel), it runs `wrangler dev` with remote bindings so the Workers AI generate_image tool works. Otherwise it falls back to `wrangler dev --local`, where every route and MCP tool works except generate_image (Workers AI is remote-only).
